so_what: The Steelers coaching change (Tomlin out, McCarthy in as playcaller) is a structural story, not just an injury one -- an already-criticized even-series RB rotation means the Dowdle/Warren backfield split is a scheme question as much as a health one going forward.

DiaperDutyDaddy is absorbing the most Week 3 uncertainty of any roster (Goedert, Barkley, Kamara/Etienne, DJ Moore, McLaurin all his) -- worth watching for outgoing trade value if he sells into it, though he still holds real QB depth most rosters lack.

Stipe is carrying real multi-position injury exposure this week (Collins out ~2 games, Jacobs still buried, Rams DEF gaining Aaron Donald back) -- a name to watch as either a buyer around Adams' expanded role or a seller if 0-2 tips toward a rebuild.

The waiver wire has real, sustained value at TE right now (Hockenson, Henry both showing genuine target-share growth through two weeks) -- the position isn't as barren league-wide as September usually makes it.
Week 3 opens with a short-week Thursday game (Packers at Falcons) and closes with the Bears hosting the Eagles Monday night, the game most likely to resolve the Caleb Williams hamstring question.
